general.title: MOSuite-filter
general.instructions: filter low counts in a multiOmicsDataSet

parameters.name: Count type
parameters.description: Type of counts to filter. Must be a count type in names(moo@counts). Counts table should not be log-transformed.

parameters.name: Group column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample group information. This is usually a column showing to which experimental treatments each sample belongs, such as WildType, Knockout, Tumor, Normal, Before, or After.

parameters.name: Minimum count value
parameters.description: Minimum value in the selected filtering table required for a sample to be considered nonzero. If use_cpm_counts_to_filter is TRUE, this threshold is applied to CPM values. If use_cpm_counts_to_filter is FALSE, this threshold is applied directly to the selected count_type table.

parameters.name: Minimum samples with nonzero counts (total)
parameters.description: Minimum number of samples in total that must meet the minimum_count_value_to_be_considered_nonzero threshold for a feature to be kept.

parameters.name: Use CPM for filtering
parameters.description: If no transformation has been performed on the counts matrix, set TRUE. If TRUE, counts are transformed to CPM and filtered based on the given criteria. If the gene counts matrix has been transformed, such as log2, CPM, FPKM, or another normalization, set FALSE. If FALSE, no further transformation is applied and features are filtered as is. For RNAseq data, raw counts should be transformed to CPM in order to properly filter.
parameters.help_text: Use TRUE for raw counts and FALSE if counts are already normalized or transformed.

parameters.name: Label column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample labels as you wish them to appear in heatmap and PCA figures. This can be the same Sample Names Column. You may select a different column with shorter labels for display on figures. The selected column should contain unique names for each sample.
parameters.help_text: Use Add labels to PCA to control whether these labels appear on PCA points.

parameters.name: Colors for plots
parameters.description: Optional colors for PCA, histogram, and heatmap plots. Colors must either be names in grDevices::colors() or valid hex codes. Unnamed colors are assigned by factor level order when the grouping column is a factor; otherwise, they follow the order in which groups first appear in the metadata column. If more groups are present than colors provided, supplied colors are used first and additional colors are generated from the selected palette for the remaining groups.
parameters.help_text: Use color names or hex codes. Supplied colors are used first; if there are more groups than colors, additional colors are generated from the MOSuite palette, with random colors only if that palette is too short.

parameters.name: Plot correlation heatmap
parameters.description: Datasets with a large number of samples may be too large to create a correlation matrix heatmap. If this function takes longer than 5 minutes to run, set to FALSE and the correlation matrix will not be created.
parameters.help_text: Set to FALSE for datasets with many samples to avoid long run times

parameters.name: Interactive plots
parameters.description: Set to TRUE to make PCA and histogram plots interactive with plotly, allowing you to hover over a point or line to view sample information. The similarity heatmap will not display if this toggle is set to TRUE.
parameters.help_text: Interactive plots allow hovering to view sample information, but correlation heatmap will not display

parameters.name: PCA component on x-axis
parameters.description: The principal component to plot on the x-axis for the PCA plot. Choices include 1, 2, 3, and additional available components.

parameters.name: PCA component on y-axis
parameters.description: The principal component to plot on the y-axis for the PCA plot. Choices include 1, 2, 3, and additional available components.

parameters.name: Legend position for PCA
parameters.description: Legend position for the PCA plot

parameters.name: Label offset x
parameters.description: Label offset x for the PCA plot

parameters.name: Label offset y
parameters.description: Label offset y for the PCA plot

parameters.name: Label font size
parameters.description: Label font size for the PCA plot

parameters.name: Point size for PCA
parameters.description: Point size for the PCA plot

parameters.name: Add labels to PCA
parameters.description: If TRUE, display labels from label_colname on PCA points. If FALSE, the PCA plot uses unlabeled points while heatmap labels still use label_colname.
parameters.help_text: Set FALSE to remove labels from PCA points.

parameters.name: Color histogram by group
parameters.description: Set to FALSE to label histogram by Sample Names, or set to TRUE to label histogram by the column selected in the Group Column Used to Color Histogram parameter.

parameters.name: Set histogram x-axis min/max
parameters.description: Whether to set minimum and maximum values for the histogram x-axis.

parameters.name: Histogram x-axis minimum
parameters.description: X-axis minimum for the histogram plot.

parameters.name: Histogram x-axis maximum
parameters.description: X-axis maximum for the histogram plot.

parameters.name: Legend font size for histogram
parameters.description: Legend font size for the histogram plot. When no value is supplied, the size is scaled automatically.

parameters.name: Legend position for histogram
parameters.description: Legend position for the histogram plot. Consider setting to none for a large number of samples.

parameters.name: Histogram legend columns
parameters.description: Number of columns for the histogram legend.

parameters.name: Use group-based filtering
parameters.description: If TRUE, only keeps features, such as genes, that have at least a certain number of samples passing the threshold in at least one group.

parameters.name: Minimum samples per group with nonzero counts
parameters.description: Only keeps genes that have at least this number of samples meeting the threshold in at least one group.

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the counts data containing the Feature IDs, usually Gene or Protein ID. This is usually the first column of the input counts matrix. Only columns of text type from the input counts matrix are available to select for this parameter.
parameters.help_text: Leaving this empty uses the first column in the counts matrix.

parameters.name: Sample ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample names. The names in this column must exactly match the names used as sample column names in the input counts matrix.
parameters.help_text: Leaving this empty uses the first column in the sample metadata.

parameters.name: Samples to include
parameters.description: Which samples would you like to include? Usually, you will choose all sample columns, or you could choose to remove certain samples. Samples excluded here will be removed in this step and from downstream analysis.
parameters.help_text: Leaving this empty includes all samples.

parameters.name: Samples to rename
parameters.description: Rename samples manually for display on the PCA plot. Use the format old_name:new_name.
